| colspan="10" align="left"|<small>'''Notes:'''</small><br />
{{refbegin}}
{{note|necklace|<small>1</small>}}<small>An Immunity Necklace was played, therefore all votes against the user were negated.</small><br />
{{note|ambassadors|<small>2</small>}}<small>At the ambassadors meeting, Dylan and Yassin agreed to eliminate Ludovic.</small><br />
{{note|penalty|<small>3</small>}}<small>At the Day 10 Reward Challenge, Javier came in last place, earning a penalty vote at his next Tribal Council. This vote did not carry through the revote.</small><br />
{{note|tie|<small>4</small>}}<small>The vote resulted in a tie. Per ''Koh-Lanta'' rules, a revote would commence.</small><br />
{{note|elim|<small>5</small>}}<small>For finishing last at the Immunity Challenge, Dylan was eliminated from the game.</small><br />
{{note|pairs|<small>6</small>}}<small>Yassin was Alban's partner during the Tied Destinies twist, therefore he was also eliminated when Alban was voted out.</small><br />
{{note|penalty2|<small>7</small>}}<small>Clémence lost a special challenge during this cycle and was penalized with a vote at the next Tribal Council. However, because she won immunity, that penalty vote was voided.</small><br />
{{note|final4|<small>8</small>}}<small>At the final four, the remaining castaways competed in an elimination challenge.</small><br />
{{refend}}
